stem:
A carpenter charges $720 for 18 hours of work. She charges the same amount of money for each hour of work.

Which table shows the relationship between the amount of time the carpenter works and the amount of money she charges?

options.label: A
options.text:
Amount of Time Worked (hours) 2 4 6 8
Amount Charged (dollars) 80 160 240 320

options.label: B
options.text:
Amount of Time Worked (hours) 19 20 21 22
Amount Charged (dollars) 720 738 756 774

options.label: C
options.text:
Amount of Time Worked (hours) 3 5 7 9
Amount Charged (dollars) 75 125 175 225

options.label: D
options.text:
Amount of Time Worked (hours) 14 15 16 17
Amount Charged (dollars) 720 720 720 720

Table B: Carpenter’s Charges with columns Amount of Time Worked (hours) and Amount Charged (dollars) with values 19-720, 20-738, 21-756, 22-774.
Table C: Carpenter’s Charges with columns Amount of Time Worked (hours) and Amount Charged (dollars) with values 3-75, 5-125, 7-175, 9-225.
Table D: Carpenter’s Charges with columns Amount of Time Worked (hours) and Amount Charged (dollars) with values 14-720, 15-720, 16-720, 17-720.
